g.text: CDN — same request, edge cache HIT vs. a cache MISS all the way to origin
Same user in Mumbai, same asset. What changes is whether the nearest edge PoP already has a copy.
CACHE MISS (first request for this asset at this edge)
Only THIS first miss pays the 230ms — every other user hitting this edge afterward gets row 1.
CACHE KEY — what the CDN treats as "the same response"
Vary by: Accept-Encoding (gzip vs br) + locale header (correct: same hit rate, still per-language)
Do NOT vary by: session cookie — if you do, every logged-in user gets their own cache entry and your hit rate collapses toward zero.
Get the vary-by list too NARROW instead (ignore locale) and you leak the wrong language to some users — same bug, opposite direction.
